description: Classifies an AI system into the EU AI Act risk tiers (prohibited, high, limited, minimal) from 9 facts about it. Returns the tier, a compliance score, findings with the legal article, the documents the tier requires, and a link to the saved report. Ask the user for any fact you do not know instead of guessing.

companyName.description: Optional, shown on the saved report.

disclosesAi.description: How users are told it is AI.

euJurisdiction.description: Whether it is offered or its output used in the EU ("spain" if Spain specifically).

hasHumanOversight.description: A person can review and override its output.

hasTechnicalDocs.description: Technical documentation of the system exists.

makesConsequentialDecisions.description: Effect on people: binding decisions, influences a human decision, or none.

processesBiometric.description: Processes biometric data (face, voice, fingerprint, emotion).

name: classify_ai_system
title: Classify an AI system under the EU AI Act
